studies.Authors: van Dijk BA, Schouten LJ, Oosterwijk E, Hulsbergen-van de Kaa CA, Kiemeney LA, Goldbohm RA, Schalken JA, van den Brandt PA
studies.Population: Netherlands Cohort Study on diet and cancer participants
studies.comparison_type: Multivitamin supplement use versus no use

sample_size.excerpt: The Netherlands Cohort Study on diet and cancer (NLCS) includes 120,852 persons, who completed a self-administered food-frequency questionnaire in 1986. After 11.3 years of follow-up, 284 cases and a random sample of 4,095 persons (subcohort) with complete data were included in multivariable analyses using a case-cohort approach.

comparison.excerpt: a somewhat increased risk with supplemental vitamin E, AD, and multivitamin use

exposure_measurement.excerpt: dietary carotenoid and vitamin intake and supplemental vitamin use

gender.excerpt: while adjusting for age, sex, smoking, body mass index, and a history of hypertension
